dct_description_sm:
Rebuild stations in New Brunswick are licensed facilities authorized to repair and rebuild damaged or salvaged vehicles in accordance with provincial regulations. This dataset identifies and maps all licensed motor vehicle rebuild stations in the province.

Please note this dataset is updated monthly.

dct_title_s: New Brunswick Motor Vehicle Rebuild Stations
